data.title: Bitcoin BIP Editor Dispute Escalates Over Luke Dashjr Removal Motion
data.description: Bitcoin Core developer and BIP Editor Mark “Murch” Erhardt formally called for Luke Dashjr removal from the Bitcoin Improvement Proposal (BIP) editorial team on Aug. 9, escalating a dispute over Dashjr’s handling of BIP110 and the proposal’s recent chain split.
